description: This is a PHP source file defining the MyTrackerAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's Performance plugin API. It implements an endpoint for listing performance trackers associated with the authenticated user, including definitions for API parameters, responses, and some unimplemented CRUD methods.

classes.name: MyTrackerAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for listing the authenticated user's performance trackers, including unimplemented methods for other CRUD operations.
